svg.title: ECS + ALB — the big picture
svg.text: ECS + ALB — how the three services, tasks and target groups fit together
Strobe Assistant: one ALB, three target groups, three ECS services. Read top → down for a request; bottom → up for how each task becomes a target.
internet-facing · TLS ends here (ACM certificate) · idle timeout 300 s

a logical home for the services — traffic never flows “through” the cluster
ECS keeping the target list in sync (control plane)
The ALB never looks at ECS — it only reads target groups. Each ECS service writes its tasks’ IP:port into
its own target group. The target group is where the load-balancer side and the compute side meet.
Example IPs are illustrative; each task gets a new private IP every time it starts.
